column1: # THE MEANING CENSUS'S CLASSIFICATION (census B2, 2026-11-19; //tools/guards:meaning_census_test reads it, report-only).
# Each row: lens | category | file glob | term glob | class | reason. The first row whose lens, category, file and term
# match a hit classifies it (* is any run of characters; a lens or category of * any). A class is
#   a  upstream meaning in the product (a finding: the edge's, or ruled to stay);
#   b  covered by a user ruling (a docs/SEMANTICS_REGISTER.md row, or FOLLOW_UPS.md §6/§7's R1-R11), named;
#   c  no upstream meaning (a false positive), with the reason.
# A reason naming a known item carries its id in brackets ([C1]); the summary counts each known item's hits.
# KNOWN rows: KNOWN | id | what | why the census may not see it (empty when it should).
KNOWN | C1 | legend-engine's union framing shape runs in product lowering (LOWERSQL-1, GUARDS-2) |
